dockerfile.description: Indicates the candidate has experience packaging applications into reproducible, portable containers, which supports consistent deployment across environments and reduces "works on my machine" issues.

docker_compose.description: Suggests familiarity with orchestrating multi-service local environments, which is valuable for developing and testing distributed systems and service dependencies.

github_actions.description: Demonstrates exposure to continuous integration practices, including automated testing, linting, and build pipelines, which are critical for maintaining code_quality and delivery velocity.

pytest_tests.description: Shows that automated tests are part of the development workflow, signalling an understanding of regression prevention, code safety, and long-term maintainability.

python_project.description: Indicates familiarity with Python packaging and dependency management conventions, which supports reproducible builds, environment isolation, and collaboration.

terraform.description: Signals experience with Infrastructure as Code, enabling version-controlled, repeatable, and auditable infrastructure changes aligned with modern cloud engineering practices.

sql.description: Indicates exposure to relational data querying and transformation, which is foundational for data-intensive systems, analytics pipelines, and backend services.

documentation_readme.description: Shows an effort to document usage, setup, or design decisions, supporting knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term maintainability within a team.

license.description: Indicates awareness of open-source licensing and intellectual property considerations, which is important for legal compliance and responsible software reuse.

pre_commit.description: Suggests the use of automated checks (formatting, linting, static analysis) before commits, helping teams enforce standards and reduce low-quality changes entering the codebase.

dependabot.description: Shows awareness of dependency hygiene and security updates, reducing the risk of known vulnerabilities and maintenance debt over time.

codeowners.description: Indicates familiarity with code ownership and review workflows, which supports accountability, clearer responsibility boundaries, and scalable team collaboration.

dbt.description: Signals experience with analytics engineering workflows, including version-controlled SQL transformations and data modeling.

airflow.description: Indicates exposure to scheduled or event-driven data pipelines using Airflow-style DAGs.

rest_api_framework.description: Suggests experience building RESTful services using common Python frameworks.

makefile.description: Indicates use of standardised developer commands for building, testing, or running the project, supporting consistency across contributors.

helm.description: Suggests experience packaging and deploying applications to Kubernetes using Helm charts, a common pattern in cloud-native environments.
